question: Which of the following drugs is useful in prophylaxis of motion sickness?
analysis: Hyoscine (also known as scopolamine) is an anticholinergic drug that is commonly used for the prophylaxis of motion sickness. It works by blocking the signals in the brain that trigger nausea and vomiting. Metoclopramide and prochlorperazine are primarily used for nausea and vomiting but are not first-line options for motion sickness prophylaxis. Ondansetron is effective for nausea and vomiting but is not specifically indicated for motion sickness.
